ko.title: 100달러 유가 시대의 난방 시즌: 원유 및 디젤 가격이 겨울철 공공요금에 미치는 영향

segments.src: With Brent crude trading near $100 a barrel and diesel prices running elevated, many households are heading into the cold months wondering what their heating bills will look like.
segments.tr: 브렌트유가 배럴당 100달러에 육박하고 디젤 가격이 높은 수준을 유지하면서, 많은 가정이 추운 겨울을 앞두고 난방비가 얼마나 나올지 걱정하고 있습니다.

segments.src: The answer depends heavily on how a home is heated, where it is located, and how much fuel was locked in before prices moved.
segments.tr: 그 답은 주택 난방 방식, 위치, 그리고 가격 변동 전에 얼마나 많은 연료를 확보해 두었는지에 따라 크게 달라집니다.

segments.src: This article explains how energy markets connect to household bills, which regions tend to be most exposed, and what budgeting and assistance options are available.
segments.tr: 이 기사에서는 에너지 시장이 가계 요금과 어떻게 연결되는지, 어떤 지역이 가장 큰 영향을 받는지, 그리고 어떤 예산 관리 및 지원 옵션을 이용할 수 있는지 설명합니다.

segments.src: It is general information, not a forecast or personal financial advice.
segments.tr: 이는 일반적인 정보이며, 예측이나 개인적인 재무 조언이 아닙니다.

segments.src: ## Why crude oil prices matter for home heating
segments.tr: ## 원유 가격이 가정 난방에 중요한 이유

segments.src: Crude oil is the raw material for heating oil, diesel and many related fuels.
segments.tr: 원유는 난방유, 디젤 및 관련 연료의 원재료입니다.

segments.src: Heating oil and on-road diesel are closely related products: both are distillates, and they are refined from the same barrel of crude.
segments.tr: 난방유와 도로용 디젤은 밀접한 관련이 있는 제품으로, 둘 다 증류유이며 같은 원유 배럴에서 정제됩니다.

segments.src: When crude rises, or when refiners and distributors face tight distillate supplies, the price of heating oil usually moves in the same direction.
segments.tr: 원유 가격이 상승하거나 정유사 및 유통업체가 증류유 공급 부족에 직면하면, 난방유 가격도 보통 같은 방향으로 움직입니다.

segments.src: Three things typically feed into what a household pays per gallon:
segments.tr: 가정이 갤런당 지불하는 비용에는 일반적으로 세 가지 요소가 작용합니다:

segments.src: - **The crude oil price.** This is the largest single input and the one most visible in the headlines.
segments.tr: - **원유 가격.** 이는 가장 큰 단일 투입 요소이며 뉴스 헤드라인에서 가장 눈에 띄는 부분입니다.

segments.src: - **Refining and distillate market conditions.** Diesel and heating oil can become more expensive than crude alone would suggest if inventories are low or refinery capacity is constrained.
segments.tr: - **정유 및 증류유 시장 상황.** 재고가 부족하거나 정유 시설 용량이 제한되면 디젤과 난방유는 원유 가격만으로 예상되는 것보다 더 비싸질 수 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Distribution and delivery costs.** Trucking, storage and local competition add to the final price, and these costs are themselves sensitive to diesel fuel.
segments.tr: - **유통 및 배송 비용.** 트럭 운송, 저장 및 지역 내 경쟁이 최종 가격에 추가되며, 이러한 비용 자체도 디젤 연료 가격에 민감합니다.

segments.src: Because the same distillate market serves trucks, farms, rail and homes, a rise in diesel can push up heating oil even when household demand is steady.
segments.tr: 동일한 증류유 시장이 트럭, 농장, 철도 및 가정에 공급되기 때문에, 가정용 수요가 일정하더라도 디젤 가격이 상승하면 난방유 가격이 오를 수 있습니다.

segments.src: ## Different fuels, different exposure
segments.tr: ## 연료별 노출 정도의 차이

segments.src: Not every household feels a spike in crude in the same way.
segments.tr: 모든 가정이 원유 가격 급등을 똑같이 체감하는 것은 아닙니다.

segments.src: ### Heating oil
segments.tr: ### 난방유

segments.src: Households that burn heating oil are the most directly exposed.
segments.tr: 난방유를 사용하는 가정이 가장 직접적인 영향을 받습니다.

segments.src: Prices are set by the market and can change from one delivery to the next.
segments.tr: 가격은 시장에 의해 결정되며 배달할 때마다 달라질 수 있습니다.

segments.src: Many customers buy a tank fill at the prevailing price, so a jump in wholesale costs can show up quickly on the next invoice.
segments.tr: 많은 고객이 당시 시장 가격으로 탱크를 채우기 때문에, 도매 비용의 급등이 다음 청구서에 즉시 반영될 수 있습니다.

segments.src: ### Propane
segments.tr: ### 프로판

segments.src: Propane prices are influenced by crude oil, but they also depend on natural gas production, export demand and regional inventories.
segments.tr: 프로판 가격은 원유의 영향을 받지만, 천연가스 생산량, 수출 수요 및 지역 재고량에도 의존합니다.

segments.src: Propane is common in rural areas without access to a gas pipeline.
segments.tr: 프로판은 가스 파이프라인이 연결되지 않은 시골 지역에서 흔히 사용됩니다.

segments.src: Customers in those areas often have fewer suppliers to choose from, which can limit their ability to shop around.
segments.tr: 해당 지역의 고객은 선택할 수 있는 공급업체가 적은 경우가 많아, 가격 비교를 통한 선택의 폭이 제한될 수 있습니다.

segments.src: ### Natural gas
segments.tr: ### 천연가스

segments.src: Natural gas is priced separately from oil, and its price depends on domestic production, storage levels, weather and export demand.
segments.tr: 천연가스는 석유와 별도로 가격이 책정되며, 국내 생산량, 저장 수준, 날씨 및 수출 수요에 따라 가격이 결정됩니다.

segments.src: A high crude price does not automatically raise natural gas bills.
segments.tr: 원유 가격이 높다고 해서 자동으로 천연가스 요금이 오르는 것은 아닙니다.

segments.src: However, energy markets are connected, and utilities pass their gas purchase costs through to customers, often with a delay and subject to regulatory review.
segments.tr: 하지만 에너지 시장은 서로 연결되어 있으며, 유틸리티 기업은 가스 구매 비용을 고객에게 전가하는데, 이는 종종 지연되거나 규제 당국의 검토를 거칩니다.

segments.src: Bills can also rise when cold weather increases consumption, regardless of price.
segments.tr: 또한 추운 날씨로 인해 소비량이 증가하면 가격과 관계없이 요금이 오를 수 있습니다.

segments.src: ### Electricity
segments.tr: ### 전기

segments.src: Electric heating, including heat pumps and baseboard heaters, is tied to the local power mix.
segments.tr: 히트 펌프와 베이스보드 히터를 포함한 전기 난방은 지역 전력 구성과 관련이 있습니다.

segments.src: In regions where natural gas sets wholesale power prices, gas market moves can show up in electric rates.
segments.tr: 천연가스가 도매 전력 가격을 결정하는 지역에서는 가스 시장의 움직임이 전기 요금에 나타날 수 있습니다.

segments.src: Oil plays a smaller role in power generation in most of the country, so the link to crude is generally indirect.
segments.tr: 대부분의 지역에서 석유가 발전에서 차지하는 비중은 작기 때문에 원유와의 연관성은 일반적으로 간접적입니다.

segments.src: ## Which regions tend to be most exposed
segments.tr: ## 가장 큰 영향을 받는 지역

segments.src: Heating oil use is concentrated in the Northeast, particularly in New England and parts of New York, Pennsylvania and the Mid-Atlantic, where older housing stock and limited pipeline gas service have kept oil furnaces in use.
segments.tr: 난방유 사용은 북동부 지역, 특히 뉴잉글랜드와 뉴욕, 펜실베이니아 및 중부 대서양 연안 일부 지역에 집중되어 있는데, 이곳은 노후 주택이 많고 파이프라인 가스 서비스가 제한적이어서 석유 난로를 계속 사용하고 있습니다.

segments.src: Households in these areas generally face the most direct pass-through from oil and distillate prices.
segments.tr: 이 지역의 가구는 일반적으로 석유 및 증류유 가격 변동을 가장 직접적으로 겪게 됩니다.

segments.src: Rural parts of the Midwest, Mountain West and South often rely on propane.
segments.tr: 중서부, 산악 서부 및 남부의 시골 지역은 종종 프로판에 의존합니다.

segments.src: These households may be exposed to both oil-linked price pressure and the availability of local supply during cold snaps.
segments.tr: 이러한 가구는 석유와 연동된 가격 압박과 한파 발생 시 지역 공급 가용성 문제에 모두 노출될 수 있습니다.

segments.src: Regions that rely mainly on natural gas or electricity, such as much of the Midwest, Mid-Atlantic cities and the Pacific Northwest, are less directly tied to crude, but they are not immune.
segments.tr: 중서부 대부분, 중부 대서양 도시 및 태평양 북서부와 같이 주로 천연가스나 전기에 의존하는 지역은 원유와 직접적인 연관성은 낮지만, 그렇다고 영향을 받지 않는 것은 아닙니다.

segments.src: Gas and power prices can rise for their own reasons, and a colder-than-normal winter raises bills in every region.
segments.tr: 가스 및 전력 가격은 자체적인 이유로 상승할 수 있으며, 평년보다 추운 겨울은 모든 지역의 요금을 인상시킵니다.

segments.src: Other factors that shape exposure include home size and insulation, furnace age and efficiency, and income.
segments.tr: 노출 정도를 결정하는 다른 요인으로는 주택 크기와 단열 상태, 난로의 노후도 및 효율성, 소득 수준 등이 있습니다.

segments.src: Lower-income households spend a larger share of their budget on energy, so the same price change can be harder for them to absorb.
segments.tr: 저소득 가구는 예산에서 에너지 비용이 차지하는 비중이 크기 때문에 동일한 가격 변동도 더 감당하기 어려울 수 있습니다.

segments.src: ## How fuel costs flow into the bill
segments.tr: ## 연료 비용이 요금에 반영되는 과정

segments.src: For delivered fuels like heating oil and propane, the path is short: wholesale price changes are reflected in the per-gallon price quoted by the local dealer, sometimes within days.
segments.tr: 난방유나 프로판처럼 배달되는 연료의 경우 경로는 짧습니다. 도매 가격 변동이 지역 판매자가 제시하는 갤런당 가격에 반영되며, 때로는 며칠 내에 반영되기도 합니다.

segments.src: For regulated gas and electric utilities, the path is longer and smoother.
segments.tr: 규제를 받는 가스 및 전기 유틸리티의 경우 경로는 더 길고 완만합니다.

segments.src: Utilities generally pass through fuel and purchased-power costs through adjustment clauses or periodic rate filings.
segments.tr: 유틸리티 기업은 일반적으로 조정 조항이나 정기적인 요금 신고를 통해 연료비 및 전력 구매 비용을 전가합니다.

segments.src: Changes can arrive months later, and regulators often spread them out over time.
segments.tr: 변동 사항은 몇 달 후에 나타날 수 있으며, 규제 당국은 종종 이를 시간 경과에 따라 분산시킵니다.

segments.src: That is why a bill can rise in the middle of winter for reasons tied to prices set earlier in the year.
segments.tr: 이것이 바로 연초에 결정된 가격과 관련된 이유로 한겨울에 요금이 오를 수 있는 이유입니다.

segments.src: In practical terms, a household's bill is the product of three things: the price per unit of energy, the number of units used, and any fixed charges.
segments.tr: 실질적으로 가계 요금은 에너지 단위당 가격, 사용한 단위 수, 그리고 고정 요금이라는 세 가지 요소의 결과물입니다.

segments.src: Prices are largely outside a household's control.
segments.tr: 가격은 대부분 가정이 통제할 수 없는 영역입니다.

segments.src: Usage is not.
segments.tr: 사용량은 그렇지 않습니다.

segments.src: ## Practical ways to manage a costlier winter
segments.tr: ## 비용이 많이 드는 겨울을 관리하는 실질적인 방법

segments.src: Households have more options than many assume.
segments.tr: 가정에는 생각보다 많은 선택지가 있습니다.

segments.src: None of the following eliminates higher prices, but together they can reduce the impact.
segments.tr: 다음 방법 중 어느 것도 가격 상승을 완전히 없애지는 못하지만, 함께 사용하면 영향을 줄일 수 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Ask about price plans.** Some heating oil and propane dealers offer fixed-price or capped-price contracts, typically arranged before the season. These can protect against increases but may also lock in a price that later proves higher than the market. Read the terms, including any minimum purchase requirements.
segments.tr: - **가격 요금제를 문의하세요.** 일부 난방유 및 프로판 판매자는 일반적으로 시즌 전에 계약하는 고정 가격 또는 상한 가격 계약을 제공합니다. 이는 가격 인상으로부터 보호할 수 있지만, 나중에 시장 가격보다 높은 가격으로 고정될 수도 있습니다. 최소 구매 요건을 포함한 약관을 읽어보세요.

segments.src: - **Consider budget billing.** Many utilities and some fuel dealers offer level-payment plans that spread expected annual costs across monthly payments. This does not lower the total, but it avoids large seasonal spikes.
segments.tr: - **예산 요금제를 고려하세요.** 많은 유틸리티 기업과 일부 연료 판매자는 예상 연간 비용을 월별로 나누어 납부하는 균등 납부 계획을 제공합니다. 이는 총액을 낮추지는 않지만, 계절별로 큰 폭의 요금 급등을 피할 수 있게 해줍니다.

segments.src: - **Compare suppliers.** Where several dealers operate, prices can differ noticeably. Asking for quotes, and asking about discounts for prompt payment or automatic delivery, can help.
segments.tr: - **공급업체를 비교하세요.** 여러 판매자가 운영되는 지역에서는 가격 차이가 눈에 띄게 날 수 있습니다. 견적을 요청하고, 조기 납부나 자동 배달에 대한 할인 혜택이 있는지 물어보는 것이 도움이 될 수 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Fill smartly.** Small, frequent top-offs can carry higher per-gallon prices at some dealers. Ask whether there are minimum or will-call pricing differences.
segments.tr: - **현명하게 채우세요.** 소량씩 자주 채우는 것은 일부 판매자에게서 갤런당 더 높은 가격을 부담하게 할 수 있습니다. 최소 주문량이나 주문 시 가격 차이가 있는지 물어보세요.

segments.src: - **Reduce demand.** Sealing air leaks, adding attic insulation, servicing the furnace, and using a programmable or smart thermostat can lower consumption. Even modest reductions in indoor temperature settings can add up over a season.
segments.tr: - **수요를 줄이세요.** 공기 누출을 막고, 다락방 단열재를 추가하고, 난로를 점검하고, 프로그래밍 가능한 스마트 온도 조절기를 사용하면 소비량을 줄일 수 있습니다. 실내 온도 설정을 조금만 낮춰도 시즌 전체로 보면 큰 차이가 납니다.

segments.src: - **Look at weatherization programs.** Federal and state weatherization programs help eligible households improve insulation and heating efficiency, which lowers bills year after year.
segments.tr: - **단열 지원 프로그램을 살펴보세요.** 연방 및 주 정부의 단열 지원 프로그램은 자격 요건을 갖춘 가정이 단열 및 난방 효율을 개선하도록 도와주며, 이는 매년 요금을 낮춰줍니다.

segments.src: ## Assistance programs
segments.tr: ## 지원 프로그램

segments.src: If higher energy costs are straining a household budget, several resources exist.
segments.tr: 에너지 비용 상승으로 가계 예산이 부담된다면 이용할 수 있는 여러 자원이 있습니다.

segments.src: - **LIHEAP.** The federal Low Income Home Energy Assistance Program helps eligible households with heating and cooling costs, and in some cases with crisis situations and weatherization. Applications are generally handled through state or local agencies. Eligibility rules and benefit amounts vary, and funding is limited, so it is worth applying early in the season.
segments.tr: - **LIHEAP.** 연방 저소득층 가정 에너지 지원 프로그램(Low Income Home Energy Assistance Program)은 자격 요건을 갖춘 가구의 냉난방 비용을 지원하며, 경우에 따라 위기 상황 및 단열 개선도 지원합니다. 신청은 일반적으로 주 또는 지역 기관을 통해 처리됩니다. 자격 규정과 혜택 금액은 다양하며 자금이 제한적이므로 시즌 초기에 신청하는 것이 좋습니다.

segments.src: - **Utility hardship funds and payment plans.** Many utilities and charitable partners offer arrears programs, payment arrangements or one-time grants. Contacting the provider before a bill goes unpaid usually opens more options.
segments.tr: - **유틸리티 고충 구제 기금 및 납부 계획.** 많은 유틸리티 기업과 자선 파트너는 미납금 프로그램, 납부 조정 또는 일회성 보조금을 제공합니다. 요금이 연체되기 전에 공급업체에 연락하면 더 많은 옵션을 찾을 수 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Winter shutoff protections.** Some states restrict utility disconnections during the coldest months. Rules differ, and they often do not apply to delivered fuels such as heating oil and propane.
segments.tr: - **겨울철 공급 중단 방지 보호.** 일부 주에서는 가장 추운 달 동안 유틸리티 공급 중단을 제한합니다. 규정은 다르며, 난방유나 프로판과 같이 배달되는 연료에는 적용되지 않는 경우가 많습니다.

segments.src: - **Local and nonprofit help.** Community action agencies, faith-based groups and 211 helplines can point to emergency fuel assistance in your area.
segments.tr: - **지역 및 비영리 단체의 도움.** 지역 사회 활동 기관, 종교 단체 및 211 헬프라인을 통해 해당 지역의 긴급 연료 지원 정보를 얻을 수 있습니다.

segments.src: For official eligibility details, check the program's own website or your state energy assistance office, since rules and funding change from year to year.
segments.tr: 공식적인 자격 세부 정보는 프로그램 자체 웹사이트나 주 에너지 지원 사무소에서 확인하세요. 규정과 자금 지원은 매년 변경되기 때문입니다.

segments.src: ## What to watch
segments.tr: ## 주목해야 할 점

segments.src: Prices can change quickly.
segments.tr: 가격은 빠르게 변할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: Developments in global supply, refinery output, inventory levels and weather can all move the market.
segments.tr: 글로벌 공급, 정유 생산량, 재고 수준 및 날씨의 변화는 모두 시장을 움직일 수 있습니다.

segments.src: Households can follow public sources such as weekly price surveys from the U.S.
segments.tr: 가정에서는 미국 에너지 정보국(U.S. Energy Information Administration)의 주간 가격 조사와 같은 공공 자료나

segments.src: Energy Information Administration and announcements from their utility regulators to understand where costs are heading.
segments.tr: 유틸리티 규제 당국의 발표를 팔로우하여 비용이 어디로 향하고 있는지 파악할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: A price near $100 a barrel does not guarantee a particular outcome for any single bill.
segments.tr: 배럴당 100달러에 가까운 가격이 개별 청구서에 특정 결과를 보장하는 것은 아닙니다.

segments.src: But for households that heat with oil or propane, it is a good reason to plan ahead: compare options, check on assistance before the first cold snap, and take inexpensive steps to use less fuel.
segments.tr: 하지만 석유나 프로판으로 난방하는 가정이라면 미리 계획을 세우는 것이 좋습니다. 옵션을 비교하고, 첫 한파가 오기 전에 지원 프로그램을 확인하며, 연료 사용을 줄이기 위한 비용이 들지 않는 조치를 취하세요.

segments.src: *This article is for general informational purposes only and does not constitute financial, investment or legal advice.
segments.tr: *이 기사는 일반적인 정보 제공 목적으로만 작성되었으며 재무, 투자 또는 법률 조언을 구성하지 않습니다.

segments.src: Energy prices and program rules change frequently; confirm current details with your fuel supplier, utility or local assistance agency.*
segments.tr: 에너지 가격과 프로그램 규정은 자주 변경되므로, 연료 공급업체, 유틸리티 기업 또는 지역 지원 기관을 통해 현재 세부 정보를 확인하세요.*

zh.title: 油价突破100美元时的取暖季：原油和柴油价格如何影响您的冬季公用事业账单

segments.src: With Brent crude trading near $100 a barrel and diesel prices running elevated, many households are heading into the cold months wondering what their heating bills will look like.
segments.tr: 随着布伦特原油在每桶100美元附近交易且柴油价格持续走高，许多家庭在进入寒冷月份时都在琢磨他们的取暖账单会变成什么样。

segments.src: The answer depends heavily on how a home is heated, where it is located, and how much fuel was locked in before prices moved.
segments.tr: 答案很大程度上取决于房屋如何取暖、其地理位置以及在价格变动之前锁定了多少燃料。

segments.src: This article explains how energy markets connect to household bills, which regions tend to be most exposed, and what budgeting and assistance options are available.
segments.tr: 本文解释了能源市场如何与家庭账单相连、哪些地区往往受到的影响最大，以及有哪些预算和援助选择可供使用。

segments.src: It is general information, not a forecast or personal financial advice.
segments.tr: 这仅是一般性信息，并非预测或个人财务建议。

segments.src: ## Why crude oil prices matter for home heating
segments.tr: ## 为什么原油价格对家庭取暖很重要

segments.src: Crude oil is the raw material for heating oil, diesel and many related fuels.
segments.tr: 原油是取暖油、柴油以及许多相关燃料的原材料。

segments.src: Heating oil and on-road diesel are closely related products: both are distillates, and they are refined from the same barrel of crude.
segments.tr: 取暖油和公路柴油是密切相关的产品：两者都是馏分油，并且由同一桶原油提炼而成。

segments.src: When crude rises, or when refiners and distributors face tight distillate supplies, the price of heating oil usually moves in the same direction.
segments.tr: 当原油上涨，或者当炼油商和分销商面临紧张的馏分油供应时，取暖油的价格通常会朝着相同的方向变动。

segments.src: Three things typically feed into what a household pays per gallon:
segments.tr: 通常有三件事会影响家庭每加仑支付的费用：

segments.src: - **The crude oil price.** This is the largest single input and the one most visible in the headlines.
segments.tr: - **原油价格。** 这是最大的单一投入，也是头条新闻中最显眼的一个。

segments.src: - **Refining and distillate market conditions.** Diesel and heating oil can become more expensive than crude alone would suggest if inventories are low or refinery capacity is constrained.
segments.tr: - **炼油和馏分油市场状况。** 如果库存较低或炼油能力受限，柴油和取暖油的价格可能会变得比单看原油价格所暗示的还要昂贵。

segments.src: - **Distribution and delivery costs.** Trucking, storage and local competition add to the final price, and these costs are themselves sensitive to diesel fuel.
segments.tr: - **分销和配送成本。** 卡车运输、仓储和本地竞争增加了最终价格，而这些成本本身对柴油燃料非常敏感。

segments.src: Because the same distillate market serves trucks, farms, rail and homes, a rise in diesel can push up heating oil even when household demand is steady.
segments.tr: 由于相同的馏分油市场服务于卡车、农场、铁路和家庭，即使在家庭需求稳定的时候，柴油的上涨也能推高取暖油价格。

segments.src: ## Different fuels, different exposure
segments.tr: ## 不同的燃料，不同的风险暴露

segments.src: Not every household feels a spike in crude in the same way.
segments.tr: 并非每个家庭都以相同的方式感受到原油的飙升。

segments.src: ### Heating oil
segments.tr: ### 取暖油

segments.src: Households that burn heating oil are the most directly exposed.
segments.tr: 燃烧取暖油的家庭受到的直接影响最大。

segments.src: Prices are set by the market and can change from one delivery to the next.
segments.tr: 价格由市场决定，并且可能在两次配送之间发生变化。

segments.src: Many customers buy a tank fill at the prevailing price, so a jump in wholesale costs can show up quickly on the next invoice.
segments.tr: 许多客户按现行价格购买一箱油，因此批发成本的跃升可以迅速体现在下一张发票上。

segments.src: ### Propane
segments.tr: ### 丙烷

segments.src: Propane prices are influenced by crude oil, but they also depend on natural gas production, export demand and regional inventories.
segments.tr: 丙烷价格受原油影响，但也取决于天然气生产、出口需求和区域库存。

segments.src: Propane is common in rural areas without access to a gas pipeline.
segments.tr: 丙烷在无法接入天然气管道的农村地区很常见。

segments.src: Customers in those areas often have fewer suppliers to choose from, which can limit their ability to shop around.
segments.tr: 这些地区的客户通常可选择的供应商较少，这可能会限制他们货比三家的能力。

segments.src: ### Natural gas
segments.tr: ### 天然气

segments.src: Natural gas is priced separately from oil, and its price depends on domestic production, storage levels, weather and export demand.
segments.tr: 天然气的定价与石油分开，其价格取决于国内生产、库存水平、天气和出口需求。

segments.src: A high crude price does not automatically raise natural gas bills.
segments.tr: 高油价并不会自动提高天然气账单。

segments.src: However, energy markets are connected, and utilities pass their gas purchase costs through to customers, often with a delay and subject to regulatory review.
segments.tr: 然而，能源市场是相互连接的，公用事业公司将购气成本转嫁给客户，通常会有所延迟并需接受监管审查。

segments.src: Bills can also rise when cold weather increases consumption, regardless of price.
segments.tr: 无论价格如何，当寒冷天气增加消耗时，账单也会上涨。

segments.src: ### Electricity
segments.tr: ### 电力

segments.src: Electric heating, including heat pumps and baseboard heaters, is tied to the local power mix.
segments.tr: 电加热，包括热泵和踢脚线加热器，与当地的电力结构挂钩。

segments.src: In regions where natural gas sets wholesale power prices, gas market moves can show up in electric rates.
segments.tr: 在天然气设定批发电价的地区，天然气市场的变动可能会体现在电费中。

segments.src: Oil plays a smaller role in power generation in most of the country, so the link to crude is generally indirect.
segments.tr: 在该国大部分地区，石油在发电中扮演的角色较小，因此与原油的联系通常是间接的。

segments.src: ## Which regions tend to be most exposed
segments.tr: ## 哪些地区往往受到的影响最大

segments.src: Heating oil use is concentrated in the Northeast, particularly in New England and parts of New York, Pennsylvania and the Mid-Atlantic, where older housing stock and limited pipeline gas service have kept oil furnaces in use.
segments.tr: 取暖油的使用集中在东北地区，特别是新英格兰以及纽约、宾夕法尼亚和中大西洋的部分地区，那里较旧的住房存量和有限的管道天然气服务使燃油炉得以继续使用。

segments.src: Households in these areas generally face the most direct pass-through from oil and distillate prices.
segments.tr: 这些地区的家庭通常面临来自石油和馏分油价格最直接的传导。

segments.src: Rural parts of the Midwest, Mountain West and South often rely on propane.
segments.tr: 中西部、山地西部和南部的农村地区经常依赖丙烷。

segments.src: These households may be exposed to both oil-linked price pressure and the availability of local supply during cold snaps.
segments.tr: 这些家庭可能既面临与石油挂钩的价格压力，又在寒潮期间面临当地供应可用性的问题。

segments.src: Regions that rely mainly on natural gas or electricity, such as much of the Midwest, Mid-Atlantic cities and the Pacific Northwest, are less directly tied to crude, but they are not immune.
segments.tr: 主要依赖天然气或电力的地区，如中西部大部分地区、中大西洋城市和太平洋西北地区，与原油的直接联系较少，但它们并非完全免疫。

segments.src: Gas and power prices can rise for their own reasons, and a colder-than-normal winter raises bills in every region.
segments.tr: 天然气和电力价格可能出于自身原因上涨，而比正常情况更冷的冬天会推高每个地区的账单。

segments.src: Other factors that shape exposure include home size and insulation, furnace age and efficiency, and income.
segments.tr: 塑造风险暴露的其他因素包括房屋大小和隔热、炉子年龄和效率以及收入。

segments.src: Lower-income households spend a larger share of their budget on energy, so the same price change can be harder for them to absorb.
segments.tr: 低收入家庭将更大比例的预算花在能源上，因此相同的价格变动对他们来说可能更难消化。

segments.src: ## How fuel costs flow into the bill
segments.tr: ## 燃料成本是如何流入账单的

segments.src: For delivered fuels like heating oil and propane, the path is short: wholesale price changes are reflected in the per-gallon price quoted by the local dealer, sometimes within days.
segments.tr: 对于取暖油和丙烷等配送燃料而言，路径很短：批发价格的变化会体现在当地经销商报价的每加仑价格中，有时在几天内就会体现出来。

segments.src: For regulated gas and electric utilities, the path is longer and smoother.
segments.tr: 对于受监管的天然气和电力公用事业公司而言，路径更长也更平缓。

segments.src: Utilities generally pass through fuel and purchased-power costs through adjustment clauses or periodic rate filings.
segments.tr: 公用事业公司通常通过调整条款或定期费率申报来转嫁燃料和购电成本。

segments.src: Changes can arrive months later, and regulators often spread them out over time.
segments.tr: 变化可能会在几个月后到来，监管机构通常会将其在一段时间内摊开。

segments.src: That is why a bill can rise in the middle of winter for reasons tied to prices set earlier in the year.
segments.tr: 这就是为什么账单可能会在仲冬上涨，其原因却与今年早些时候确定的价格有关。

segments.src: In practical terms, a household's bill is the product of three things: the price per unit of energy, the number of units used, and any fixed charges.
segments.tr: 在实际操作中，家庭的账单是三件事的乘积：每单位能源的价格、使用的单位数以及任何固定费用。

segments.src: Prices are largely outside a household's control.
segments.tr: 价格在很大程度上超出了家庭的控制范围。

segments.src: Usage is not.
segments.tr: 使用量则不然。

segments.src: ## Practical ways to manage a costlier winter
segments.tr: ## 管理成本更高冬天的实用方法

segments.src: Households have more options than many assume.
segments.tr: 家庭拥有的选择比许多人想象的要多。

segments.src: None of the following eliminates higher prices, but together they can reduce the impact.
segments.tr: 以下各项都无法消除更高的价格，但它们共同可以减少影响。

segments.src: - **Ask about price plans.** Some heating oil and propane dealers offer fixed-price or capped-price contracts, typically arranged before the season. These can protect against increases but may also lock in a price that later proves higher than the market. Read the terms, including any minimum purchase requirements.
segments.tr: - **询问价格计划。** 一些取暖油和丙烷经销商提供固定价格或上限价格合同，通常在季节前安排。这些可以防范上涨，但也可能锁定一个后来证明比市场更高的价格。阅读条款，包括任何最低采购要求。

segments.src: - **Consider budget billing.** Many utilities and some fuel dealers offer level-payment plans that spread expected annual costs across monthly payments. This does not lower the total, but it avoids large seasonal spikes.
segments.tr: - **考虑预算账单。** 许多公用事业公司和一些燃料经销商提供将预计的年度成本分摊到每月付款中的水平支付计划。这不会降低总额，但可以避免大的季节性飙升。

segments.src: - **Compare suppliers.** Where several dealers operate, prices can differ noticeably. Asking for quotes, and asking about discounts for prompt payment or automatic delivery, can help.
segments.tr: - **比较供应商。** 在有多个经销商运营的地方，价格可能会有明显的不同。索取报价，并询问关于按时付款或自动配送折扣的信息，会有所帮助。

segments.src: - **Fill smartly.** Small, frequent top-offs can carry higher per-gallon prices at some dealers. Ask whether there are minimum or will-call pricing differences.
segments.tr: - **明智地加注。** 在某些经销商处，小额、频繁的补给可能会带有更高的每加仑价格。询问是否存在最低或自提定价差异。

segments.src: - **Reduce demand.** Sealing air leaks, adding attic insulation, servicing the furnace, and using a programmable or smart thermostat can lower consumption. Even modest reductions in indoor temperature settings can add up over a season.
segments.tr: - **减少需求。** 密封漏风处、增加阁楼隔热、维护炉子以及使用可编程或智能恒温器可以降低消耗。即使是室内温度设置的微幅降低，在一个季节里也能积少成多。

segments.src: - **Look at weatherization programs.** Federal and state weatherization programs help eligible households improve insulation and heating efficiency, which lowers bills year after year.
segments.tr: - **看看天气改造计划。** 联邦和州的天气改造计划帮助符合条件的家庭改善隔热和供暖效率，从而年复一年地降低账单。

segments.src: ## Assistance programs
segments.tr: ## 援助计划

segments.src: If higher energy costs are straining a household budget, several resources exist.
segments.tr: 如果更高的能源成本正在拉紧家庭预算，存在几种资源。

segments.src: - **LIHEAP.** The federal Low Income Home Energy Assistance Program helps eligible households with heating and cooling costs, and in some cases with crisis situations and weatherization. Applications are generally handled through state or local agencies. Eligibility rules and benefit amounts vary, and funding is limited, so it is worth applying early in the season.
segments.tr: - **LIHEAP。** 联邦低收入家庭能源援助计划帮助符合条件的家庭支付冷暖费用，在某些情况下还帮助应对危机情况和天气改造。申请通常通过州或地方机构处理。资格规则和福利金额各不相同，资金有限，因此在季节初申请是值得的。

segments.src: - **Utility hardship funds and payment plans.** Many utilities and charitable partners offer arrears programs, payment arrangements or one-time grants. Contacting the provider before a bill goes unpaid usually opens more options.
segments.tr: - **公用事业困难基金和付款计划。** 许多公用事业公司和慈善合作伙伴提供欠款计划、付款安排或一次性赠款。在账单未付之前联系供应商通常会开启更多选择。

segments.src: - **Winter shutoff protections.** Some states restrict utility disconnections during the coldest months. Rules differ, and they often do not apply to delivered fuels such as heating oil and propane.
segments.tr: - **冬季断电保护。** 一些州限制在最冷的月份断开公用事业连接。规则有所不同，而且它们通常不适用于取暖油和丙烷等配送燃料。

segments.src: - **Local and nonprofit help.** Community action agencies, faith-based groups and 211 helplines can point to emergency fuel assistance in your area.
segments.tr: - **地方和非营利组织帮助。** 社区行动机构、宗教团体和211求助热线可以指出您所在地区的紧急燃料援助。

segments.src: For official eligibility details, check the program's own website or your state energy assistance office, since rules and funding change from year to year.
segments.tr: 有关官方资格详情，请查看该计划自己的网站或您所在州的能源援助办公室，因为规则和资金每年都在变化。

segments.src: ## What to watch
segments.tr: ## 需要关注什么

segments.src: Prices can change quickly.
segments.tr: 价格可能会快速变化。

segments.src: Developments in global supply, refinery output, inventory levels and weather can all move the market.
segments.tr: 全球供应、炼油厂产出、库存水平和天气的发展都可能推动市场。

segments.src: Households can follow public sources such as weekly price surveys from the U.S.
segments.tr: 家庭可以关注公共来源，例如来自美国能源信息署的每周价格调查以及其公用事业监管机构的公告，以了解成本的走向。

segments.src: Energy Information Administration and announcements from their utility regulators to understand where costs are heading.
segments.tr: 能源信息管理局和来自其公用事业监管机构的公告，以了解成本的走向。

segments.src: A price near $100 a barrel does not guarantee a particular outcome for any single bill.
segments.tr: 每桶100美元左右的价格并不能保证任何单一账单的特定结果。

segments.src: But for households that heat with oil or propane, it is a good reason to plan ahead: compare options, check on assistance before the first cold snap, and take inexpensive steps to use less fuel.
segments.tr: 但对于用石油或丙烷取暖的家庭来说，这是提前计划的好理由：比较选项，在第一场寒潮来临之前检查援助，并采取低成本的步骤来减少燃料使用。

hi.title: $100 के तेल के साथ हीटिंग सीजन: क्रूड और डीजल की कीमतें आपके सर्दियों के यूटिलिटी बिल को कैसे प्रभावित कर सकती हैं

segments.src: With Brent crude trading near $100 a barrel and diesel prices running elevated, many households are heading into the cold months wondering what their heating bills will look like.
segments.tr: ब्रेंट क्रूड के लगभग $100 प्रति बैरल पर कारोबार करने और डीजल की कीमतों के उच्च स्तर पर रहने के कारण, कई परिवार सर्दियों के महीनों में प्रवेश करते हुए यह सोच रहे हैं कि उनके हीटिंग बिल कैसे होंगे।

segments.src: The answer depends heavily on how a home is heated, where it is located, and how much fuel was locked in before prices moved.
segments.tr: इसका उत्तर काफी हद तक इस बात पर निर्भर करता है कि घर को कैसे गर्म किया जाता है, वह कहाँ स्थित है, और कीमतें बढ़ने से पहले कितना ईंधन पहले ही बुक कर लिया गया था।

segments.src: This article explains how energy markets connect to household bills, which regions tend to be most exposed, and what budgeting and assistance options are available.
segments.tr: यह लेख बताता है कि ऊर्जा बाजार घरेलू बिलों से कैसे जुड़ते हैं, किन क्षेत्रों पर सबसे अधिक प्रभाव पड़ने की संभावना है, और बजट तथा सहायता के क्या विकल्प उपलब्ध हैं।

segments.src: It is general information, not a forecast or personal financial advice.
segments.tr: यह सामान्य जानकारी है, कोई पूर्वानुमान या व्यक्तिगत वित्तीय सलाह नहीं।

segments.src: ## Why crude oil prices matter for home heating
segments.tr: ## घरेलू हीटिंग के लिए कच्चे तेल की कीमतें क्यों मायने रखती हैं

segments.src: Crude oil is the raw material for heating oil, diesel and many related fuels.
segments.tr: कच्चा तेल हीटिंग ऑयल, डीजल और कई संबंधित ईंधनों के लिए कच्चा माल है।

segments.src: Heating oil and on-road diesel are closely related products: both are distillates, and they are refined from the same barrel of crude.
segments.tr: हीटिंग ऑयल और ऑन-रोड डीजल निकटता से संबंधित उत्पाद हैं: दोनों डिस्टिलेट हैं, और वे कच्चे तेल के एक ही बैरल से रिफाइन किए जाते हैं।

segments.src: When crude rises, or when refiners and distributors face tight distillate supplies, the price of heating oil usually moves in the same direction.
segments.tr: जब कच्चे तेल की कीमत बढ़ती है, या जब रिफाइनरों और वितरकों को डिस्टिलेट की सीमित आपूर्ति का सामना करना पड़ता है, तो हीटिंग ऑयल की कीमत आमतौर पर उसी दिशा में बढ़ती है।

segments.src: Three things typically feed into what a household pays per gallon:
segments.tr: तीन चीजें आमतौर पर इस बात को प्रभावित करती हैं कि कोई परिवार प्रति गैलन कितना भुगतान करता है:

segments.src: - **The crude oil price.** This is the largest single input and the one most visible in the headlines.
segments.tr: - **कच्चे तेल की कीमत।** यह सबसे बड़ा एकल इनपुट है और सुर्खियों में सबसे ज्यादा दिखाई देता है।

segments.src: - **Refining and distillate market conditions.** Diesel and heating oil can become more expensive than crude alone would suggest if inventories are low or refinery capacity is constrained.
segments.tr: - **रिफाइनिंग और डिस्टिलेट बाजार की स्थितियां।** यदि इन्वेंट्री कम है या रिफाइनरी की क्षमता सीमित है, तो डीजल और हीटिंग ऑयल केवल कच्चे तेल की तुलना में अधिक महंगे हो सकते हैं।

segments.src: - **Distribution and delivery costs.** Trucking, storage and local competition add to the final price, and these costs are themselves sensitive to diesel fuel.
segments.tr: - **वितरण और डिलीवरी लागत।** ट्रकिंग, भंडारण और स्थानीय प्रतिस्पर्धा अंतिम कीमत में जुड़ती है, और ये लागतें स्वयं डीजल ईंधन के प्रति संवेदनशील होती हैं।

segments.src: Because the same distillate market serves trucks, farms, rail and homes, a rise in diesel can push up heating oil even when household demand is steady.
segments.tr: क्योंकि एक ही डिस्टिलेट बाजार ट्रकों, खेतों, रेल और घरों को सेवा प्रदान करता है, डीजल में वृद्धि हीटिंग ऑयल की कीमतों को बढ़ा सकती है, भले ही घरेलू मांग स्थिर हो।

segments.src: ## Different fuels, different exposure
segments.tr: ## विभिन्न ईंधन, विभिन्न प्रभाव

segments.src: Not every household feels a spike in crude in the same way.
segments.tr: हर परिवार कच्चे तेल में उछाल को एक ही तरह से महसूस नहीं करता है।

segments.src: ### Heating oil
segments.tr: ### हीटिंग ऑयल

segments.src: Households that burn heating oil are the most directly exposed.
segments.tr: जो परिवार हीटिंग ऑयल जलाते हैं, वे सबसे सीधे प्रभावित होते हैं।

segments.src: Prices are set by the market and can change from one delivery to the next.
segments.tr: कीमतें बाजार द्वारा तय की जाती हैं और एक डिलीवरी से दूसरी डिलीवरी में बदल सकती हैं।

segments.src: Many customers buy a tank fill at the prevailing price, so a jump in wholesale costs can show up quickly on the next invoice.
segments.tr: कई ग्राहक प्रचलित मूल्य पर टैंक भरवाते हैं, इसलिए थोक लागत में उछाल अगले इनवॉइस में जल्दी दिखाई दे सकता है।

segments.src: ### Propane
segments.tr: ### प्रोपेन

segments.src: Propane prices are influenced by crude oil, but they also depend on natural gas production, export demand and regional inventories.
segments.tr: प्रोपेन की कीमतें कच्चे तेल से प्रभावित होती हैं, लेकिन वे प्राकृतिक गैस उत्पादन, निर्यात मांग और क्षेत्रीय इन्वेंट्री पर भी निर्भर करती हैं।

segments.src: Propane is common in rural areas without access to a gas pipeline.
segments.tr: गैस पाइपलाइन तक पहुंच के बिना ग्रामीण क्षेत्रों में प्रोपेन आम है।

segments.src: Customers in those areas often have fewer suppliers to choose from, which can limit their ability to shop around.
segments.tr: उन क्षेत्रों के ग्राहकों के पास अक्सर चुनने के लिए कम आपूर्तिकर्ता होते हैं, जो उनकी बाजार में तुलना करके खरीदारी करने की क्षमता को सीमित कर सकते हैं।

segments.src: ### Natural gas
segments.tr: ### प्राकृतिक गैस

segments.src: Natural gas is priced separately from oil, and its price depends on domestic production, storage levels, weather and export demand.
segments.tr: प्राकृतिक गैस की कीमत तेल से अलग तय की जाती है, और इसकी कीमत घरेलू उत्पादन, भंडारण स्तर, मौसम और निर्यात मांग पर निर्भर करती है।

segments.src: A high crude price does not automatically raise natural gas bills.
segments.tr: कच्चे तेल की उच्च कीमत स्वचालित रूप से प्राकृतिक गैस के बिलों को नहीं बढ़ाती है।

segments.src: However, energy markets are connected, and utilities pass their gas purchase costs through to customers, often with a delay and subject to regulatory review.
segments.tr: हालांकि, ऊर्जा बाजार आपस में जुड़े हुए हैं, और यूटिलिटीज अपनी गैस खरीद लागत को ग्राहकों तक पहुंचाती हैं, अक्सर देरी के साथ और नियामक समीक्षा के अधीन।

segments.src: Bills can also rise when cold weather increases consumption, regardless of price.
segments.tr: ठंड के मौसम में खपत बढ़ने पर भी बिल बढ़ सकते हैं, चाहे कीमत कुछ भी हो।

segments.src: ### Electricity
Electric heating, including heat pumps and baseboard heaters, is tied to the local power mix.
segments.tr: हीट पंप और बेसबोर्ड हीटर सहित इलेक्ट्रिक हीटिंग, स्थानीय पावर मिक्स से जुड़ी है।

segments.src: In regions where natural gas sets wholesale power prices, gas market moves can show up in electric rates.
segments.tr: उन क्षेत्रों में जहां प्राकृतिक गैस थोक बिजली की कीमतें तय करती है, गैस बाजार में बदलाव बिजली की दरों में दिखाई दे सकते हैं।

segments.src: Oil plays a smaller role in power generation in most of the country, so the link to crude is generally indirect.
segments.tr: देश के अधिकांश हिस्सों में बिजली उत्पादन में तेल की भूमिका कम होती है, इसलिए कच्चे तेल से संबंध आम तौर पर अप्रत्यक्ष होता है।

segments.src: ## Which regions tend to be most exposed
segments.tr: ## किन क्षेत्रों पर सबसे अधिक प्रभाव पड़ता है

segments.src: Heating oil use is concentrated in the Northeast, particularly in New England and parts of New York, Pennsylvania and the Mid-Atlantic, where older housing stock and limited pipeline gas service have kept oil furnaces in use.
segments.tr: हीटिंग ऑयल का उपयोग पूर्वोत्तर में केंद्रित है, विशेष रूप से न्यू इंग्लैंड और न्यूयॉर्क, पेंसिल्वेनिया और मध्य-अटलांटिक के कुछ हिस्सों में, जहां पुराने आवासों और सीमित पाइपलाइन गैस सेवा ने तेल भट्टियों को उपयोग में बनाए रखा है।

segments.src: Households in these areas generally face the most direct pass-through from oil and distillate prices.
segments.tr: इन क्षेत्रों के परिवारों को आमतौर पर तेल और डिस्टिलेट कीमतों का सबसे सीधा असर झेलना पड़ता है।

segments.src: Rural parts of the Midwest, Mountain West and South often rely on propane.
segments.tr: मिडवेस्ट, माउंटेन वेस्ट और दक्षिण के ग्रामीण हिस्से अक्सर प्रोपेन पर निर्भर रहते हैं।

segments.src: These households may be exposed to both oil-linked price pressure and the availability of local supply during cold snaps.
segments.tr: ये परिवार कड़ाके की ठंड के दौरान तेल से जुड़े मूल्य दबाव और स्थानीय आपूर्ति की उपलब्धता दोनों से प्रभावित हो सकते हैं।

segments.src: Regions that rely mainly on natural gas or electricity, such as much of the Midwest, Mid-Atlantic cities and the Pacific Northwest, are less directly tied to crude, but they are not immune.
segments.tr: जो क्षेत्र मुख्य रूप से प्राकृतिक गैस या बिजली पर निर्भर हैं, जैसे कि अधिकांश मिडवेस्ट, मध्य-अटलांटिक शहर और पैसिफिक नॉर्थवेस्ट, वे कच्चे तेल से सीधे कम जुड़े हुए हैं, लेकिन वे पूरी तरह सुरक्षित नहीं हैं।

segments.src: Gas and power prices can rise for their own reasons, and a colder-than-normal winter raises bills in every region.
segments.tr: गैस और बिजली की कीमतें अपने स्वयं के कारणों से बढ़ सकती हैं, और सामान्य से अधिक ठंडी सर्दी हर क्षेत्र में बिल बढ़ा देती है।

segments.src: Other factors that shape exposure include home size and insulation, furnace age and efficiency, and income.
segments.tr: प्रभाव को आकार देने वाले अन्य कारकों में घर का आकार और इन्सुलेशन, भट्टी की उम्र और दक्षता, और आय शामिल हैं।

segments.src: Lower-income households spend a larger share of their budget on energy, so the same price change can be harder for them to absorb.
segments.tr: कम आय वाले परिवार अपने बजट का एक बड़ा हिस्सा ऊर्जा पर खर्च करते हैं, इसलिए वही मूल्य परिवर्तन उनके लिए वहन करना अधिक कठिन हो सकता है।

segments.src: ## How fuel costs flow into the bill
segments.tr: ## ईंधन लागत बिल में कैसे जुड़ती है

segments.src: For delivered fuels like heating oil and propane, the path is short: wholesale price changes are reflected in the per-gallon price quoted by the local dealer, sometimes within days.
segments.tr: हीटिंग ऑयल और प्रोपेन जैसे डिलीवर किए जाने वाले ईंधनों के लिए, मार्ग छोटा है: थोक मूल्य में परिवर्तन स्थानीय डीलर द्वारा बताए गए प्रति-गैलन मूल्य में कभी-कभी कुछ दिनों के भीतर दिखाई देते हैं।

segments.src: For regulated gas and electric utilities, the path is longer and smoother.
segments.tr: नियंत्रित गैस और इलेक्ट्रिक यूटिलिटीज के लिए, मार्ग लंबा और अधिक सुचारू होता है।

segments.src: Utilities generally pass through fuel and purchased-power costs through adjustment clauses or periodic rate filings.
segments.tr: यूटिलिटीज आम तौर पर समायोजन क्लॉज़ या आवधिक दर दाखिलों के माध्यम से ईंधन और खरीदी गई बिजली की लागत को पास करती हैं।

segments.src: Changes can arrive months later, and regulators often spread them out over time.
segments.tr: बदलाव महीनों बाद आ सकते हैं, और नियामक अक्सर उन्हें समय के साथ फैला देते हैं।

segments.src: That is why a bill can rise in the middle of winter for reasons tied to prices set earlier in the year.
segments.tr: इसलिए साल के शुरू में तय की गई कीमतों से जुड़े कारणों से सर्दियों के मध्य में बिल बढ़ सकता है।

segments.src: In practical terms, a household's bill is the product of three things: the price per unit of energy, the number of units used, and any fixed charges.
segments.tr: व्यावहारिक शब्दों में, एक परिवार का बिल तीन चीजों का उत्पाद होता है: ऊर्जा की प्रति यूनिट कीमत, इस्तेमाल की गई यूनिटों की संख्या, और कोई भी निश्चित शुल्क।

segments.src: Prices are largely outside a household's control.
segments.tr: कीमतें काफी हद तक परिवार के नियंत्रण से बाहर हैं।

segments.src: Usage is not.
segments.tr: उपयोग नियंत्रण में है।

segments.src: ## Practical ways to manage a costlier winter
segments.tr: ## अधिक महंगी सर्दियों को प्रबंधित करने के व्यावहारिक तरीके

segments.src: Households have more options than many assume.
segments.tr: परिवारों के पास कई लोग जितना सोचते हैं उससे कहीं अधिक विकल्प हैं।

segments.src: None of the following eliminates higher prices, but together they can reduce the impact.
segments.tr: निम्नलिखित में से कोई भी बढ़ी हुई कीमतों को खत्म नहीं करता है, लेकिन साथ मिलकर वे प्रभाव को कम कर सकते हैं।

segments.src: - **Ask about price plans.** Some heating oil and propane dealers offer fixed-price or capped-price contracts, typically arranged before the season. These can protect against increases but may also lock in a price that later proves higher than the market. Read the terms, including any minimum purchase requirements.
segments.tr: - **मूल्य योजनाओं के बारे में पूछें।** कुछ हीटिंग ऑयल और प्रोपेन डीलर निश्चित-मूल्य या कैप-प्राइस अनुबंधों की पेशकश करते हैं, जो आमतौर पर सीजन से पहले व्यवस्थित किए जाते हैं। ये कीमतों में वृद्धि से बचा सकते हैं लेकिन एक ऐसी कीमत भी लॉक कर सकते हैं जो बाद में बाजार से अधिक साबित हो सकती है। किसी भी न्यूनतम खरीद आवश्यकताओं सहित शर्तों को पढ़ें।

segments.src: - **Consider budget billing.** Many utilities and some fuel dealers offer level-payment plans that spread expected annual costs across monthly payments. This does not lower the total, but it avoids large seasonal spikes.
segments.tr: - **बजट बिलिंग पर विचार करें।** कई यूटिलिटीज और कुछ ईंधन डीलर लेवल-पेमेंट प्लान पेश करते हैं जो मासिक भुगतानों में अनुमानित वार्षिक लागत को फैला देते हैं। इससे कुल लागत कम नहीं होती, लेकिन यह बड़े मौसमी उछालों से बचाती है।

segments.src: - **Compare suppliers.** Where several dealers operate, prices can differ noticeably. Asking for quotes, and asking about discounts for prompt payment or automatic delivery, can help.
segments.tr: - **आपूर्तिकर्ताओं की तुलना करें।** जहां कई डीलर काम करते हैं, वहां कीमतों में ध्यान देने योग्य अंतर हो सकता है। कोटेशन मांगना, और त्वरित भुगतान या स्वचालित डिलीवरी के लिए छूट के बारे में पूछना मदद कर सकता है।

segments.src: - **Fill smartly.** Small, frequent top-offs can carry higher per-gallon prices at some dealers. Ask whether there are minimum or will-call pricing differences.
segments.tr: - **समझदारी से भरवाएं।** छोटी, बार-बार टॉप-ऑफ करने पर कुछ डीलरों के पास प्रति-गैलन कीमतें अधिक हो सकती हैं। पूछें कि क्या न्यूनतम या विल-कॉल मूल्य निर्धारण में अंतर है।

segments.src: - **Reduce demand.** Sealing air leaks, adding attic insulation, servicing the furnace, and using a programmable or smart thermostat can lower consumption. Even modest reductions in indoor temperature settings can add up over a season.
segments.tr: - **मांग कम करें।** हवा के रिसाव को सील करना, अटारी इन्सुलेशन जोड़ना, भट्टी की सर्विसिंग करना, और एक प्रोग्रामेबल या स्मार्ट थर्मोस्टेट का उपयोग करना खपत को कम कर सकता है। इनडोर तापमान सेटिंग्स में मामूली कटौती भी एक पूरे सीजन में बड़ा अंतर ला सकती है।

segments.src: - **Look at weatherization programs.** Federal and state weatherization programs help eligible households improve insulation and heating efficiency, which lowers bills year after year.
segments.tr: - **वेदराइजेशन कार्यक्रमों को देखें।** संघीय और राज्य वेदराइजेशन कार्यक्रम पात्र परिवारों को इन्सुलेशन और हीटिंग दक्षता में सुधार करने में मदद करते हैं, जिससे साल-दर-साल बिल कम होते हैं।

segments.src: ## Assistance programs
segments.tr: ## सहायता कार्यक्रम

segments.src: If higher energy costs are straining a household budget, several resources exist.
segments.tr: यदि ऊर्जा की उच्च लागत घरेलू बजट पर दबाव डाल रही है, तो कई संसाधन मौजूद हैं।

segments.src: - **LIHEAP.** The federal Low Income Home Energy Assistance Program helps eligible households with heating and cooling costs, and in some cases with crisis situations and weatherization. Applications are generally handled through state or local agencies. Eligibility rules and benefit amounts vary, and funding is limited, so it is worth applying early in the season.
segments.tr: - **LIHEAP।** संघीय निम्न आय गृह ऊर्जा सहायता कार्यक्रम (LIHEAP) पात्र परिवारों को हीटिंग और कूलिंग लागतों में मदद करता है, और कुछ मामलों में संकट की स्थितियों और वेदराइजेशन में भी। आवेदनों को आमतौर पर राज्य या स्थानीय एजेंसियों के माध्यम से संभाला जाता है। पात्रता नियम और लाभ की राशि भिन्न होती है, और धन सीमित होता है, इसलिए सीजन में जल्दी आवेदन करना फायदेमंद होता है।

segments.src: - **Utility hardship funds and payment plans.** Many utilities and charitable partners offer arrears programs, payment arrangements or one-time grants. Contacting the provider before a bill goes unpaid usually opens more options.
segments.tr: - **यूटिलिटी कठिनाई कोष और भुगतान योजनाएं।** कई यूटिलिटीज और धर्मार्थ साझेदार बकाये के कार्यक्रम, भुगतान व्यवस्था या एकमुश्त अनुदान प्रदान करते हैं। बिल का भुगतान न होने से पहले प्रदाता से संपर्क करने से आमतौर पर अधिक विकल्प मिलते हैं।

segments.src: - **Winter shutoff protections.** Some states restrict utility disconnections during the coldest months. Rules differ, and they often do not apply to delivered fuels such as heating oil and propane.
segments.tr: - **सर्दियों में कनेक्शन काटने से सुरक्षा।** कुछ राज्य सबसे ठंडे महीनों के दौरान यूटिलिटी कनेक्शन काटने को सीमित करते हैं। नियम अलग-अलग होते हैं, और वे अक्सर डिलीवर किए जाने वाले ईधंनों जैसे हीटिंग ऑयल और प्रोपेन पर लागू नहीं होते हैं।

segments.src: - **Local and nonprofit help.** Community action agencies, faith-based groups and 211 helplines can point to emergency fuel assistance in your area.
segments.tr: - **स्थानीय और गैर-लाभकारी मदद।** कम्युनिटी एक्शन एजेंसियां, आस्था-आधारित समूह और 211 हेल्पलाइन आपके क्षेत्र में आपातकालीन ईंधन सहायता की ओर इशारा कर सकते हैं।

segments.src: For official eligibility details, check the program's own website or your state energy assistance office, since rules and funding change from year to year.
segments.tr: आधिकारिक पात्रता विवरण के लिए, कार्यक्रम की अपनी वेबसाइट या अपने राज्य ऊर्जा सहायता कार्यालय की जांच करें, क्योंकि नियम और फंडिंग साल-दर-साल बदलते रहते हैं।

segments.src: ## What to watch
segments.tr: ## किन बातों पर ध्यान दें

segments.src: Prices can change quickly.
segments.tr: कीमतें तेजी से बदल सकती हैं।

segments.src: Developments in global supply, refinery output, inventory levels and weather can all move the market.
segments.tr: वैश्विक आपूर्ति, रिफाइनरी उत्पादन, इन्वेंट्री स्तर और मौसम में घटनाक्रम बाजार को प्रभावित कर सकते हैं।

segments.src: Households can follow public sources such as weekly price surveys from the U.S.
segments.tr: लागत किस दिशा में जा रही है, यह समझने के लिए परिवार अमेरिकी ऊर्जा सूचना प्रशासन (EIA) के साप्ताहिक मूल्य सर्वेक्षणों और अपनी यूटिलिटी नियामकों की घोषणाओं जैसे सार्वजनिक स्रोतों का पालन कर सकते हैं।

segments.src: Energy Information Administration and announcements from their utility regulators to understand where costs are heading.
A price near $100 a barrel does not guarantee a particular outcome for any single bill.
segments.tr: $100 प्रति बैरल के आसपास की कीमत किसी भी single बिल के लिए किसी विशेष परिणाम की गारंटी नहीं देती है।

segments.src: But for households that heat with oil or propane, it is a good reason to plan ahead: compare options, check on assistance before the first cold snap, and take inexpensive steps to use less fuel.
segments.tr: लेकिन जो परिवार तेल या प्रोपेन से हीटिंग करते हैं, उनके लिए यह आगे की योजना बनाने का एक अच्छा कारण है: विकल्पों की तुलना करें, पहली ठंड से पहले सहायता की जांच करें, और कम ईंधन का उपयोग करने के लिए सस्ते कदम उठाएं।

es.title: Temporada de calefacción con petróleo a $100: cómo los precios del crudo y el diésel podrían afectar su factura de servicios públicos de invierno

segments.src: With Brent crude trading near $100 a barrel and diesel prices running elevated, many households are heading into the cold months wondering what their heating bills will look like.
segments.tr: Con el crudo Brent cotizando cerca de los $100 por barril y los precios del diésel elevados, muchos hogares se dirigen hacia los meses fríos preguntándose cómo serán sus facturas de calefacción.

segments.src: The answer depends heavily on how a home is heated, where it is located, and how much fuel was locked in before prices moved.
segments.tr: La respuesta depende en gran medida de cómo se calienta un hogar, dónde está ubicado y cuánto combustible se aseguró antes de que los precios se movieran.

segments.src: This article explains how energy markets connect to household bills, which regions tend to be most exposed, and what budgeting and assistance options are available.
segments.tr: Este artículo explica cómo los mercados energéticos se conectan con las facturas de los hogares, qué regiones tienden a estar más expuestas y qué opciones de presupuesto y asistencia están disponibles.

segments.src: It is general information, not a forecast or personal financial advice.
segments.tr: Es información general, no un pronóstico ni asesoramiento financiero personal.

segments.src: ## Why crude oil prices matter for home heating
segments.tr: ## Por qué los precios del petróleo crudo son importantes para la calefacción del hogar

segments.src: Crude oil is the raw material for heating oil, diesel and many related fuels.
segments.tr: El petróleo crudo es la materia prima para el combustible de calefacción, el diésel y muchos combustibles relacionados.

segments.src: Heating oil and on-road diesel are closely related products: both are distillates, and they are refined from the same barrel of crude.
segments.tr: El combustible de calefacción y el diésel para carretera son productos estrechamente relacionados: ambos son destilados y se refinan a partir del mismo barril de crudo.

segments.src: When crude rises, or when refiners and distributors face tight distillate supplies, the price of heating oil usually moves in the same direction.
segments.tr: Cuando el crudo sube, o cuando las refinerías y distribuidores enfrentan suministros limitados de destilados, el precio del combustible de calefacción generalmente se mueve en la misma dirección.

segments.src: Three things typically feed into what a household pays per gallon:
segments.tr: Tres factores suelen influir en lo que un hogar paga por galón:

segments.src: - **The crude oil price.** This is the largest single input and the one most visible in the headlines.
segments.tr: - **El precio del petróleo crudo.** Este es el insumo individual más grande y el más visible en los titulares.

segments.src: - **Refining and distillate market conditions.** Diesel and heating oil can become more expensive than crude alone would suggest if inventories are low or refinery capacity is constrained.
segments.tr: - **Las condiciones del mercado de refinación y destilados.** El diésel y el combustible de calefacción pueden volverse más caros de lo que sugeriría el crudo por sí solo si los inventarios son bajos o la capacidad de refinación es limitada.

segments.src: - **Distribution and delivery costs.** Trucking, storage and local competition add to the final price, and these costs are themselves sensitive to diesel fuel.
segments.tr: - **Costos de distribución y entrega.** El transporte, el almacenamiento y la competencia local se suman al precio final, y estos costos son en sí mismos sensibles al combustible diésel.

segments.src: Because the same distillate market serves trucks, farms, rail and homes, a rise in diesel can push up heating oil even when household demand is steady.
segments.tr: Debido a que el mismo mercado de destilados sirve a camiones, granjas, ferrocarriles y hogares, un aumento en el diésel puede elevar el combustible de calefacción incluso cuando la demanda de los hogares es estable.

segments.src: ## Different fuels, different exposure
segments.tr: ## Diferentes combustibles, diferente exposición

segments.src: Not every household feels a spike in crude in the same way.
segments.tr: No todos los hogares sienten un aumento en el crudo de la misma manera.

segments.src: ### Heating oil
segments.tr: ### Combustible de calefacción

segments.src: Households that burn heating oil are the most directly exposed.
segments.tr: Los hogares que queman combustible de calefacción son los más directamente expuestos.

segments.src: Prices are set by the market and can change from one delivery to the next.
segments.tr: Los precios los fija el mercado y pueden cambiar de una entrega a la siguiente.

segments.src: Many customers buy a tank fill at the prevailing price, so a jump in wholesale costs can show up quickly on the next invoice.
segments.tr: Muchos clientes compran un llenado de tanque al precio vigente, por lo que un salto en los costos mayoristas puede aparecer rápidamente en la próxima factura.

segments.src: ### Propane
segments.tr: ### Propano

segments.src: Propane prices are influenced by crude oil, but they also depend on natural gas production, export demand and regional inventories.
segments.tr: Los precios del propano están influenciados por el petróleo crudo, pero también dependen de la producción de gas natural, la demanda de exportación y los inventarios regionales.

segments.src: Propane is common in rural areas without access to a gas pipeline.
segments.tr: El propano es común en áreas rurales sin acceso a un gasoducto.

segments.src: Customers in those areas often have fewer suppliers to choose from, which can limit their ability to shop around.
segments.tr: Los clientes en esas áreas a menudo tienen menos proveedores para elegir, lo que puede limitar su capacidad de comparar precios.

segments.src: ### Natural gas
segments.tr: ### Gas natural

segments.src: Natural gas is priced separately from oil, and its price depends on domestic production, storage levels, weather and export demand.
segments.tr: El gas natural tiene un precio separado del petróleo, y su precio depende de la producción nacional, los niveles de almacenamiento, el clima y la demanda de exportación.

segments.src: A high crude price does not automatically raise natural gas bills.
segments.tr: Un precio alto del crudo no aumenta automáticamente las facturas de gas natural.

segments.src: However, energy markets are connected, and utilities pass their gas purchase costs through to customers, often with a delay and subject to regulatory review.
segments.tr: Sin embargo, los mercados energéticos están conectados y las empresas de servicios públicos trasladan sus costos de compra de gas a los clientes, a menudo con un retraso y sujetos a revisión regulatoria.

segments.src: Bills can also rise when cold weather increases consumption, regardless of price.
segments.tr: Las facturas también pueden aumentar cuando el clima frío aumenta el consumo, independientemente del precio.

segments.src: ### Electricity
segments.tr: ### Electricidad

segments.src: Electric heating, including heat pumps and baseboard heaters, is tied to the local power mix.
segments.tr: La calefacción eléctrica, incluidas las bombas de calor y los calentadores de zócalo, está vinculada a la combinación de energía local.

segments.src: In regions where natural gas sets wholesale power prices, gas market moves can show up in electric rates.
segments.tr: En regiones donde el gas natural fija los precios mayoristas de la energía, los movimientos del mercado del gas pueden aparecer en las tarifas eléctricas.

segments.src: Oil plays a smaller role in power generation in most of the country, so the link to crude is generally indirect.
segments.tr: El petróleo juega un papel menor en la generación de energía en la mayor parte del país, por lo que el vínculo con el crudo es generalmente indirecto.

segments.src: ## Which regions tend to be most exposed
segments.tr: ## Qué regiones tienden a estar más expuestas

segments.src: Heating oil use is concentrated in the Northeast, particularly in New England and parts of New York, Pennsylvania and the Mid-Atlantic, where older housing stock and limited pipeline gas service have kept oil furnaces in use.
segments.tr: El uso de combustible de calefacción se concentra en el noreste, particularmente en Nueva Inglaterra y partes de Nueva York, Pensilvania y el Atlántico Medio, donde las viviendas más antiguas y el servicio limitado de gas por tubería han mantenido en uso los hornos de petróleo.

segments.src: Households in these areas generally face the most direct pass-through from oil and distillate prices.
segments.tr: Los hogares en estas áreas generalmente enfrentan el traslado más directo de los precios del petróleo y los destilados.

segments.src: Rural parts of the Midwest, Mountain West and South often rely on propane.
segments.tr: Las partes rurales del Medio Oeste, el Oeste Montañoso y el Sur a menudo dependen del propano.

segments.src: These households may be exposed to both oil-linked price pressure and the availability of local supply during cold snaps.
segments.tr: Estos hogares pueden estar expuestos tanto a la presión de precios vinculada al petróleo como a la disponibilidad de suministro local durante las olas de frío.

segments.src: Regions that rely mainly on natural gas or electricity, such as much of the Midwest, Mid-Atlantic cities and the Pacific Northwest, are less directly tied to crude, but they are not immune.
segments.tr: Las regiones que dependen principalmente del gas natural o la electricidad, como gran parte del Medio Oeste, las ciudades del Atlántico Medio y el Noroeste del Pacífico, están menos directamente vinculadas al crudo, pero no son inmunes.

segments.src: Gas and power prices can rise for their own reasons, and a colder-than-normal winter raises bills in every region.
segments.tr: Los precios del gas y la energía pueden subir por sus propias razones, y un invierno más frío de lo normal aumenta las facturas en todas las regiones.

segments.src: Other factors that shape exposure include home size and insulation, furnace age and efficiency, and income.
segments.tr: Otros factores que moldean la exposición incluyen el tamaño y el aislamiento del hogar, la antigüedad y eficiencia del horno, y los ingresos.

segments.src: Lower-income households spend a larger share of their budget on energy, so the same price change can be harder for them to absorb.
segments.tr: Los hogares de bajos ingresos gastan una mayor parte de su presupuesto en energía, por lo que el mismo cambio de precio puede ser más difícil de absorber para ellos.

segments.src: ## How fuel costs flow into the bill
segments.tr: ## Cómo fluyen los costos del combustible hacia la factura

segments.src: For delivered fuels like heating oil and propane, the path is short: wholesale price changes are reflected in the per-gallon price quoted by the local dealer, sometimes within days.
segments.tr: Para los combustibles entregados como el de calefacción y el propano, el camino es corto: los cambios en los precios mayoristas se reflejan en el precio por galón cotizado por el distribuidor local, a veces en cuestión de días.

segments.src: For regulated gas and electric utilities, the path is longer and smoother.
segments.tr: Para las empresas de servicios públicos reguladas de gas y electricidad, el camino es más largo y fluido.

segments.src: Utilities generally pass through fuel and purchased-power costs through adjustment clauses or periodic rate filings.
segments.tr: Las empresas de servicios públicos generalmente trasladan los costos de combustible y energía comprada a través de cláusulas de ajuste o presentaciones periódicas de tarifas.

segments.src: Changes can arrive months later, and regulators often spread them out over time.
segments.tr: Los cambios pueden llegar meses después, y los reguladores a menudo los distribuyen a lo largo del tiempo.

segments.src: That is why a bill can rise in the middle of winter for reasons tied to prices set earlier in the year.
segments.tr: Es por eso que una factura puede aumentar a mitad del invierno por razones vinculadas a precios fijados a principios de año.

segments.src: In practical terms, a household's bill is the product of three things: the price per unit of energy, the number of units used, and any fixed charges.
segments.tr: En términos prácticos, la factura de un hogar es el producto de tres cosas: el precio por unidad de energía, la cantidad de unidades utilizadas y cualquier cargo fijo.

segments.src: Prices are largely outside a household's control.
segments.tr: Los precios están en gran medida fuera del control de un hogar.

segments.src: Usage is not.
segments.tr: El uso no lo está.

segments.src: ## Practical ways to manage a costlier winter
segments.tr: ## Formas prácticas de gestionar un invierno más costoso

segments.src: Households have more options than many assume.
segments.tr: Los hogares tienen más opciones de las que muchos suponen.

segments.src: None of the following eliminates higher prices, but together they can reduce the impact.
segments.tr: Nada de lo siguiente elimina los precios más altos, pero juntos pueden reducir el impacto.

segments.src: - **Ask about price plans.** Some heating oil and propane dealers offer fixed-price or capped-price contracts, typically arranged before the season. These can protect against increases but may also lock in a price that later proves higher than the market. Read the terms, including any minimum purchase requirements.
segments.tr: - **Pregunte sobre los planes de precios.** Algunos distribuidores de combustible de calefacción y propano ofrecen contratos de precio fijo o precio tope, generalmente organizados antes de la temporada. Estos pueden proteger contra aumentos, pero también pueden fijar un precio que luego resulte ser más alto que el del mercado. Lea los términos, incluidos los requisitos mínimos de compra.

segments.src: - **Consider budget billing.** Many utilities and some fuel dealers offer level-payment plans that spread expected annual costs across monthly payments. This does not lower the total, but it avoids large seasonal spikes.
segments.tr: - **Considere la facturación presupuestaria.** Muchas empresas de servicios públicos y algunos distribuidores de combustible ofrecen planes de pago nivelado que distribuyen los costos anuales esperados en pagos mensuales. Esto no reduce el total, pero evita grandes picos estacionales.

segments.src: - **Compare suppliers.** Where several dealers operate, prices can differ noticeably. Asking for quotes, and asking about discounts for prompt payment or automatic delivery, can help.
segments.tr: - **Compare proveedores.** Donde operan varios distribuidores, los precios pueden diferir notablemente. Pedir cotizaciones y preguntar sobre descuentos por pago puntual o entrega automática puede ayudar.

segments.src: - **Fill smartly.** Small, frequent top-offs can carry higher per-gallon prices at some dealers. Ask whether there are minimum or will-call pricing differences.
segments.tr: - **Llene de manera inteligente.** Las recargas pequeñas y frecuentes pueden conllevar precios por galón más altos en algunos distribuidores. Pregunte si hay diferencias de precios por mínimos o por pedido bajo demanda.

segments.src: - **Reduce demand.** Sealing air leaks, adding attic insulation, servicing the furnace, and using a programmable or smart thermostat can lower consumption. Even modest reductions in indoor temperature settings can add up over a season.
segments.tr: - **Reduzca la demanda.** Sellar fugas de aire, agregar aislamiento al ático, realizar mantenimiento al horno y usar un termostato programable o inteligente puede reducir el consumo. Incluso reducciones modestas en los ajustes de temperatura interior pueden acumularse durante una temporada.

segments.src: - **Look at weatherization programs.** Federal and state weatherization programs help eligible households improve insulation and heating efficiency, which lowers bills year after year.
segments.tr: - **Consulte los programas de climatización.** Los programas de climatización federales y estatales ayudan a los hogares elegibles a mejorar el aislamiento y la eficiencia de la calefacción, lo que reduce las facturas año tras año.

segments.src: ## Assistance programs
segments.tr: ## Programas de asistencia

segments.src: If higher energy costs are straining a household budget, several resources exist.
segments.tr: Si los costos de energía más altos están afectando el presupuesto de un hogar, existen varios recursos.

segments.src: - **LIHEAP.** The federal Low Income Home Energy Assistance Program helps eligible households with heating and cooling costs, and in some cases with crisis situations and weatherization. Applications are generally handled through state or local agencies. Eligibility rules and benefit amounts vary, and funding is limited, so it is worth applying early in the season.
segments.tr: - **LIHEAP.** El Programa federal de Asistencia de Energía para Hogares de Bajos Ingresos ayuda a los hogares elegibles con los costos de calefacción y refrigeración, y en algunos casos con situaciones de crisis y climatización. Las solicitudes generalmente se manejan a través de agencias estatales o locales. Las reglas de elegibilidad y los montos de los beneficios varían, y los fondos son limitados, por lo que vale la pena solicitarlo al principio de la temporada.

segments.src: - **Utility hardship funds and payment plans.** Many utilities and charitable partners offer arrears programs, payment arrangements or one-time grants. Contacting the provider before a bill goes unpaid usually opens more options.
segments.tr: - **Fondos de ayuda y planes de pago de servicios públicos.** Muchas empresas de servicios públicos y socios caritativos ofrecen programas de atrasos, acuerdos de pago o subvenciones únicas. Contactar al proveedor antes de que una factura quede impaga suele abrir más opciones.

segments.src: - **Winter shutoff protections.** Some states restrict utility disconnections during the coldest months. Rules differ, and they often do not apply to delivered fuels such as heating oil and propane.
segments.tr: - **Protecciones contra cortes en invierno.** Algunos estados restringen las desconexiones de servicios públicos durante los meses más fríos. Las reglas difieren y, a menudo, no se aplican a los combustibles entregados como el combustible de calefacción y el propano.

segments.src: - **Local and nonprofit help.** Community action agencies, faith-based groups and 211 helplines can point to emergency fuel assistance in your area.
segments.tr: - **Ayuda local y sin fines de lucro.** Las agencias de acción comunitaria, los grupos religiosos y las líneas de ayuda 211 pueden señalar la asistencia de emergencia de combustible en su área.

segments.src: For official eligibility details, check the program's own website or your state energy assistance office, since rules and funding change from year to year.
segments.tr: Para obtener detalles oficiales de elegibilidad, consulte el sitio web del programa o la oficina de asistencia energética de su estado, ya que las reglas y los fondos cambian de un año a otro.

segments.src: ## What to watch
segments.tr: ## Qué observar

segments.src: Prices can change quickly.
segments.tr: Los precios pueden cambiar rápidamente.

segments.src: Developments in global supply, refinery output, inventory levels and weather can all move the market.
segments.tr: Los desarrollos en el suministro global, la producción de las refinerías, los niveles de inventario y el clima pueden mover el mercado.

segments.src: Households can follow public sources such as weekly price surveys from the U.S.

segments.src: Energy Information Administration and announcements from their utility regulators to understand where costs are heading.
segments.tr: Energy Information Administration y los anuncios de sus reguladores de servicios públicos para comprender hacia dónde se dirigen los costos.

segments.src: A price near $100 a barrel does not guarantee a particular outcome for any single bill.
segments.tr: Un precio cercano a los $100 por barril no garantiza un resultado particular para ninguna factura individual.

segments.src: But for households that heat with oil or propane, it is a good reason to plan ahead: compare options, check on assistance before the first cold snap, and take inexpensive steps to use less fuel.
segments.tr: Pero para los hogares que se calientan con petróleo o propano, es una buena razón para planificar con anticipación: compare opciones, verifique la asistencia antes de la primera ola de frío y tome medidas económicas para usar menos combustible.

segments.src: With Brent crude trading near $100 a barrel and diesel prices running elevated, many households are heading into the cold months wondering what their heating bills will look like.
segments.tr: مع تداول خام برنت بالقرب من 100 دولار للبرميل وارتفاع أسعار الديزل، تتجه العديد من الأسر نحو أشهر البرد وهي تتساءل عن شكل فواتير التدفئة الخاصة بها.

segments.src: The answer depends heavily on how a home is heated, where it is located, and how much fuel was locked in before prices moved.

segments.src: ## Why crude oil prices matter for home heating
segments.tr: ## لماذا تعتبر أسعار النفط الخام مهمة للتدفئة المنزلية

segments.src: Crude oil is the raw material for heating oil, diesel and many related fuels.
segments.tr: النفط الخام هو المادة الخام لزيت التدفئة والديزل والعديد من الوقود المرتبط به.

segments.src: Heating oil and on-road diesel are closely related products: both are distillates, and they are refined from the same barrel of crude.
segments.tr: يعتبر زيت التدفئة وديزل الطرق منتجين مرتبطان ارتباطًا وثيقًا: كلاهما نواتج تقطير، ويتم تكريرهما من نفس برميل الخام.

segments.src: When crude rises, or when refiners and distributors face tight distillate supplies, the price of heating oil usually moves in the same direction.
segments.tr: عندما يرتفع النفط الخام، أو عندما يواجه المصافون والموزعون نقصًا في إمدادات النواتج المقطرة، يتحرك سعر زيت التدفئة عادةً في نفس الاتجاه.

segments.src: Three things typically feed into what a household pays per gallon:
segments.tr: تساهم ثلاثة أمور عادةً فيما تدفعه الأسرة لكل جالون:

segments.src: - **The crude oil price.** This is the largest single input and the one most visible in the headlines.
segments.tr: - **The crude oil price.** This is the largest single input and the one most visible in the headlines.

segments.src: - **Refining and distillate market conditions.** Diesel and heating oil can become more expensive than crude alone would suggest if inventories are low or refinery capacity is constrained.
segments.tr: - **Refining and distillate market conditions.** Diesel and heating oil can become more expensive than crude alone would suggest if inventories are low or refinery capacity is constrained.

segments.src: - **Distribution and delivery costs.** Trucking, storage and local competition add to the final price, and these costs are themselves sensitive to diesel fuel.
segments.tr: - **Distribution and delivery costs.** Trucking, storage and local competition add to the final price, and these costs are themselves sensitive to diesel fuel.

segments.src: Because the same distillate market serves trucks, farms, rail and homes, a rise in diesel can push up heating oil even when household demand is steady.
segments.tr: نظرًا لأن نفس سوق النواتج المقطرة يخدم الشاحنات والمزارع والسكك الحديدية والمنازل، فإن ارتفاع الديزل يمكن أن يدفع زيت التدفئة للارتفاع حتى عندما يكون طلب الأسرة ثابتًا.

segments.src: ## Different fuels, different exposure
segments.tr: ## وقود مختلف، وتعرض مختلف

segments.src: Not every household feels a spike in crude in the same way.
segments.tr: لا تشعر كل أسرة بارتفاع النفط الخام بنفس الطريقة.

segments.src: ### Heating oil
segments.tr: ### زيت التدفئة

segments.src: Households that burn heating oil are the most directly exposed.
segments.tr: الأسر التي تحرق زيت التدفئة هي الأكثر تعرضًا بشكل مباشر.

segments.src: Prices are set by the market and can change from one delivery to the next.
segments.tr: تُحدد الأسعار حسب السوق ويمكن أن تتغير من تسليم إلى آخر.

segments.src: Many customers buy a tank fill at the prevailing price, so a jump in wholesale costs can show up quickly on the next invoice.
segments.tr: يشتري العديد من العملاء تعبئة خزان بالسعر السائد، لذا فإن قفزة في تكاليف الجملة يمكن أن تظهر بسرعة في الفاتورة التالية.

segments.src: ### Propane
segments.tr: ### البروبان

segments.src: Propane prices are influenced by crude oil, but they also depend on natural gas production, export demand and regional inventories.
segments.tr: تتأثر أسعار البروبان بالنفط الخام، لكنها تعتمد أيضًا على إنتاج الغاز الطبيعي، وطلب التصدير، والمخزونات الإقليمية.

segments.src: Propane is common in rural areas without access to a gas pipeline.
segments.tr: البروبان شائع في المناطق الريفية التي ليس لها إمكانية الوصول إلى خط أنابيب الغاز.

segments.src: Customers in those areas often have fewer suppliers to choose from, which can limit their ability to shop around.
segments.tr: غالبًا ما يكون لدى العملاء في تلك المناطق عدد أقل من الموردين للاختيار من بينهم، مما قد يحد من قدرتهم على التسوق المقارن.

segments.src: ### Natural gas
segments.tr: ### الغاز الطبيعي

segments.src: Natural gas is priced separately from oil, and its price depends on domestic production, storage levels, weather and export demand.
segments.tr: يتم تسعير الغاز الطبيعي بشكل منفصل عن النفط، ويسعره يعتمد على الإنتاج المحلي، ومستويات التخزين، والطقس، وطلب التصدير.

segments.src: A high crude price does not automatically raise natural gas bills.
segments.tr: سعر الخام المرتفع لا يرفع فواتير الغاز الطبيعي تلقائيًا.

segments.src: However, energy markets are connected, and utilities pass their gas purchase costs through to customers, often with a delay and subject to regulatory review.
segments.tr: ومع ذلك، فإن أسواق الطاقة مترابطة، وتمرر المرافق تكاليف شراء الغاز إلى العملاء، وغالبًا ما يكون ذلك بتأخير وخاضعًا للمراجعة التنظيمية.

segments.src: Bills can also rise when cold weather increases consumption, regardless of price.
segments.tr: يمكن أن تزيد الفواتير أيضًا عندما يزيد الطقس البارد من الاستهلاك، بغض النظر عن السعر.

segments.src: ### Electricity
segments.tr: ### الكهرباء

segments.src: Electric heating, including heat pumps and baseboard heaters, is tied to the local power mix.
segments.tr: التدفئة الكهربائية، بما في ذلك مضخات الحرارة وسخانات الألواح القاعدة، ترتبط بمزيج الطاقة المحلي.

segments.src: In regions where natural gas sets wholesale power prices, gas market moves can show up in electric rates.
segments.tr: في المناطق التي يحدد فيها الغاز الطبيعي أسعار الطاقة بالجملة، يمكن أن تظهر تحركات سوق الغاز في أسعار الكهرباء.

segments.src: Oil plays a smaller role in power generation in most of the country, so the link to crude is generally indirect.
segments.tr: يلعب النفط دورًا أصغر في توليد الطاقة في معظم أنحاء البلاد، لذا فإن الارتباط بالخام يكون غير مباشر بشكل عام.

segments.src: ## Which regions tend to be most exposed
segments.tr: ## المناطق التي تميل إلى أن تكون أكثر عرضة للخطر

segments.src: Heating oil use is concentrated in the Northeast, particularly in New England and parts of New York, Pennsylvania and the Mid-Atlantic, where older housing stock and limited pipeline gas service have kept oil furnaces in use.
segments.tr: تركز استخدام زيت التدفئة في الشمال الشرقي، لا سيما في نيو إنغلاند وأجزاء من نيويورك وبنسلفانيا ومنطقة الأطلسي الأوسط، حيث حافظت المباني السكنية القديمة وخدمة غاز خطوط الأنابيب المحدودة على استخدام أفران النفط.

segments.src: Households in these areas generally face the most direct pass-through from oil and distillate prices.
segments.tr: تواجه الأسر في هذه المناطق عمومًا النقل المباشر الأكثر لمعايير أسعار النفط والنواتج المقطرة.

segments.src: Rural parts of the Midwest, Mountain West and South often rely on propane.
segments.tr: تعمد الأجزاء الريفية من الغرب الأوسط، وغرب الجبل، والجنوب غالبًا على البروبان.

segments.src: These households may be exposed to both oil-linked price pressure and the availability of local supply during cold snaps.
segments.tr: قد تتعرض هذه الأسر لكل من ضغط الأسعار المرتبط بالنفط وتوفر الإمدادات المحلية خلال موجات البرد.

segments.src: Regions that rely mainly on natural gas or electricity, such as much of the Midwest, Mid-Atlantic cities and the Pacific Northwest, are less directly tied to crude, but they are not immune.
segments.tr: المناطق التي تعتمد بشكل أساسي على الغاز الطبيعي أو الكهرباء، مثل الكثير من الغرب الأوسط، ومدن الأطلسي الأوسط، وشمال غرب المحيط الهادئ، ترتبط بشكل أقل مباشرة بالخام، لكنها ليست محصنة.

segments.src: Gas and power prices can rise for their own reasons, and a colder-than-normal winter raises bills in every region.
segments.tr: يمكن أن ترفع أسعار الغاز والطاقة لأسبابها الخاصة، والشتاء الأكثر برودة من المعتاد يرفع الفواتير في كل منطقة.

segments.src: Other factors that shape exposure include home size and insulation, furnace age and efficiency, and income.
segments.tr: العوامل الأخرى التي تشكل التعرض تشمل حجم المنزل والعزل، وعمر الفرن وكفاءته، والدخل.

segments.src: Lower-income households spend a larger share of their budget on energy, so the same price change can be harder for them to absorb.
segments.tr: تنفق الأسر ذات الدخل المنخفض حصة أكبر من ميزانيتها على الطاقة، لذا فإن نفس التغير في السعر قد يكون من الصعب عليها استيعابه.

segments.src: ## How fuel costs flow into the bill
segments.tr: ## كيف تتدفق تكاليف الوقود إلى الفاتورة

segments.src: For delivered fuels like heating oil and propane, the path is short: wholesale price changes are reflected in the per-gallon price quoted by the local dealer, sometimes within days.
segments.tr: بالنسبة للوقود المسلم مثل زيت التدفئة والبروبان، المسار قصير: تنعكس تغييرات أسعار الجملة في سعر الجالون الذي يقتبسه التاجر المحلي، وأحيانًا في غضون أيام.

segments.src: For regulated gas and electric utilities, the path is longer and smoother.
segments.tr: بالنسبة لمرافق الغاز والكهرباء الخاضعة للتنظيم، المسار أطول وأكثر سلاسة.

segments.src: Utilities generally pass through fuel and purchased-power costs through adjustment clauses or periodic rate filings.
segments.tr: تمرر المرافق عمومًا تكاليف الوقود والطاقة المشتراة من خلال بنود التعديل أو إيداعات الأسعار دورية.

segments.src: Changes can arrive months later, and regulators often spread them out over time.
segments.tr: يمكن أن تصل التغييرات بعد أشهر، وغالبًا ما يوزعها المنظمون بمرور الوقت.

segments.src: That is why a bill can rise in the middle of winter for reasons tied to prices set earlier in the year.
segments.tr: لهذا السبب يمكن أن ترتفع الفاتورة في منتصف الشتاء لأسباب مرتبطة بالأسعار المحددة في وقت سابق من العام.

segments.src: In practical terms, a household's bill is the product of three things: the price per unit of energy, the number of units used, and any fixed charges.
segments.tr: من الناحية العملية، فاتورة الأسرة هي حاصل ضرب ثلاثة أمور: السعر لكل وحدة طاقة، وعدد الوحدات المستهلكة، وأي رسوم ثابتة.

segments.src: Prices are largely outside a household's control.
segments.tr: الأسعار خارجة إلى حد كبير عن سيطرة الأسرة.

segments.src: Usage is not.
segments.tr: الاستخدام ليس كذلك.

segments.src: ## Practical ways to manage a costlier winter
segments.tr: ## طرق عملية لإدارة شتاء أكثر تكلفة

segments.src: Households have more options than many assume.
segments.tr: لدى الأسر خيارات أكثر مما يظن الكثيرون.

segments.src: None of the following eliminates higher prices, but together they can reduce the impact.
segments.tr: لا شيء مما يلي يلغي الأسعار المرتفعة، ولكنها مجتمعة يمكن أن تقلل من التأثير.

segments.src: ## What to watch
segments.tr: ## ما يجب مراقبته
